**Blog Outline: iPhone vs. Samsung Galaxy – Which Flagship Wins?**

**I. Introduction**
- Brief overview of both models
- Why this comparison matters to buyers

**II. Design & Build Quality**
- Materials, dimensions, weight
- Durability and water resistance
- Color options and in-hand feel

**III. Display**
- Size, resolution, refresh rate
- Brightness and outdoor visibility

**IV. Performance**
- Processor and RAM
- Benchmark results
- Gaming and multitasking in real-world use

**V. Camera**
- Hardware specs (main, ultrawide, telephoto)
- Photo quality in daylight and low light
- Video capabilities

**VI. Battery & Charging**
- Battery life tests
- Wired and wireless charging speeds

**VII. Software & User Experience**
- iOS vs. Android/One UI
- Ecosystem integration
- AI features and update support length

**VIII. Price & Value**
- Storage tiers and pricing
- Trade-in deals and long-term value

**IX. Verdict**
- Summary comparison table
- Best choice for different users (photographers, gamers, ecosystem loyalists)

**X. Conclusion**
- Final recommendation
- Invite reader comments
